_doc: Scientific audit of the served model. Changing label_reconstruction_complete to true requires corrected labels and a full rerun of the v3 protocol.
title: Scientific warning: 5 November 2026 audit of the v3 model
summary: The v3 scores reproduce, but its labels do not mainly measure new water in the marshland. Do not treat v3 as validated marshland-water forecasting or use it to recommend interventions.
findings: 83% (7-day) and 87% (14-day) of formation events lie within 100 m of the lake.

Sentinel-1C verifies 80% (7-day) and 73% (14-day) of evaluation events and is not harmonised. On track 123 over 500 m from the lake, Sentinel-1A verified 0 events in 23,195 rows and Sentinel-1C verified 385 in 20,783.
297 of the 598 evaluated sites are outside Gikomero Sector.
required_before_upgrade: Correct for Sentinel-1C, rebuild labels and features, rerun the v3 protocol, and report lake-shore and inland sites separately.
